Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df <- read_csv("Teen_Mental_Health_Dataset.csv")

glimpse(df)
```


```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = daily_social_media_hours)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "pink", color = "hotpink") +
  theme_minimal()
```

**dataset overview:** the data that contains 1200 rows and 13 variables tracking how teens use social media and they were asleep and mental health metrics.
**Social Media Usage:** daily social media hours are evenly spread across the data ranging from one to eight hours per day.
